entries.description: Agent persona/identity as Antigravity workspace rules (GEMINI.md, always-on, highest precedence). Additive context — Antigravity offers no system-prompt override, so this is the strongest identity mechanism available.
Each published skill as an Antigravity Agent Skill (workspace .agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md; .agents is the 2.0 convention).

Workspace MCP config: routes theorymcp through the mcp-remote stdio OAuth bridge (Antigravity speaks stdio but cannot perform the MCP OAuth flow; mcp-remote terminates it). {{mcp.url}} = the agent route.
